ios.desc:
BondBeyond is the couples app you use together. It helps you say what you mean, feel heard and grow closer, in a few minutes a day.

HOW IT WORKS
• Invite your partner with one link. Each of you uses BondBeyond on your own phone.
• Share how you feel in one tap. Your partner sees it and gets gentle words to answer, send love or start a talk.
• Rate what matters to you, like trust, time together and family. See where you two agree and what is worth a talk.

SAY IT WITHOUT THE FIGHT
• Write what is on your mind and tap "Help me say it". Your coach turns blame into words your partner can hear.
• Talk privately with your coach, or invite your partner to a talk for two.
• Practice a hard conversation before you have it.

FEEL CLOSER EVERY DAY
• Daily Spark: one light question for both of you.
• Send love in one tap, even from your home screen widget.
• Love Tank: see how loved your partner feels this week.
• Plans made for you two: short guided steps for trust, communication and connection.
• Memory Lane: your story together in photos and moments.
• Couple games and questions that show how well you know each other.

PRIVATE TO YOU TWO
Your feelings and answers are shared only with your partner, never posted publicly. You can delete your account and your data at any time.

FREE TO START
Use BondBeyond free with your partner. Premium covers you both, monthly or yearly, and unlocks unlimited coaching and more plans, games and quizzes for dating, engaged, married and long-distance couples.

FEEL CLOSER OR GET YOUR MONEY BACK
On your first Premium payment: if you both open BondBeyond on 20 of your first 30 days and don't feel closer, ask for a refund on day 30. On iPhone, the app opens Apple's refund request for you.

BondBeyond is not a replacement for therapy. Many couples use it alongside counseling, or as a simple daily habit to stay connected.

Questions or feedback? contact@diapp.tech
